case.question: What does NAB cash earnings mean in FY2025?

response.question: What does NAB cash earnings mean in FY2025?

answer.message:
Qwen-generated explanation, with automated checks:

NAB cash earnings in FY2025 is a non-IFRS key financial performance measure used by NAB and the investment community. [NAB FY2025 Full Year Results, PDF page 9]

NAB cash earnings in FY2025 is defined as net profit attributable to owners of the Company from continuing operations adjusted for non-cash items. [NAB FY2025 Full Year Results, PDF page 82]

NAB cash earnings in FY2025 is not a statutory financial measure and is not presented in accordance with Australian Accounting Standards. [NAB FY2025 Full Year Results, PDF page 9]

NAB cash earnings in FY2025 includes adjustments for non-cash items such as hedging, fair value volatility, amortisation of acquired intangible assets, and gains or losses associated with acquisitions, integrations, disposals, or closures of Group businesses. [NAB FY2025 Full Year Results, PDF page 82]

NAB cash earnings in FY2025 is used for internal management reporting and reflects what NAB considers to be the underlying performance of the Group. [NAB FY2025 Full Year Results, PDF page 9]

NAB cash earnings in FY2025 is not audited or reviewed in accordance with Australian Auditing Standards. [NAB FY2025 Full Year Results, PDF page 9]

excerpts.quote: Cash earnings is a non-IFRS key financial performance measure used by NAB and the investment community. NAB also uses cash earnings for its internal management reporting as it better reflects what NAB considers to be the underlying performance of the Group. Cash earnings is not a statutory financial measure, is not presented in accordance with Australian Accounting Standards, and is not audited or reviewed in accordance with Australian Auditing Standards. The 2025 Full Year Results Management Discussion and Analysis provides details of how cash earnings is defined on page 10 and a discussion of non-cash earnings items and full reconciliation of statutory net profit attributable to owners of the Company on pages 72 to 74.
